title: Outbuilding wall height (3 m, or 3.5 m where materials match the dwelling)
text: Table 2.6a maximum wall height 3m. C2.6.2 Notwithstanding C2.6.1(i), an outbuilding can have a wall height of up to 3.5m where the external wall and roof materials and finishes (including colour) are the same as those of the dwelling on the same site. Outbuildings will need to comply with the NCC requirements, including but not limited to fire separation.

exceptions.label: C2.6.2: external wall and roof materials, finishes and colour match the dwelling

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: C2.6.2 (p22) says 'Notwithstanding C2.6.1(i)' but C2.6.1(i) is the lot-boundary cross-reference; read as modifying the Table 2.6a wall height. Figure 2.6a illustrates wall and total height.

verified.note: Values (3m, 3.5m) match p22. Ambiguous on the page: C2.6.2 says 'Notwithstanding C2.6.1(i)', but C2.6.1(i) is the lot boundary setback cross-reference, not the wall height in Table 2.6a.
